subject: session date
fact: The events occur on the 4th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493.
source_quote: ## 4th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: tower chamber
fact: The floor of the tower chamber is littered with the bodies of dead drow.
source_quote: The body of the dead drow litter the floor.

subject: Prince Derendil
fact: Prince Derendil's large corpse stands as a silent monument to the price of victory.
source_quote: The large corpse of the deluded Prince Derendil stands as a silent monument to the price of the victory.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir scours the bodies of the dead drow for weapons.
source_quote: Zalthir shows no sentimentality and quickly scours the bodies for any weapons.

subject: studded leather armor
fact: Sarith arms himself with studded leather armor.
source_quote: Sarith arms himself with studded leather armor

subject: shield
fact: Sarith picks up a shield.
source_quote: picks up a shield

subject: hand crossbow
fact: Sarith places one of the hand crossbows in a strap on his armor.
source_quote: places one of the hand crossbows in a strap on the armor.

subject: poisoned hand crossbow bolts
fact: Grygum finds some poisoned hand crossbow bolts.
source_quote: Grygum finds some poisoned hand crossbow bolts

subject: vial of Drow poison
fact: Grygum finds a vial of what Sarith explains is Drow poison.
source_quote: a vial of what Sarith explains is Drow poison.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz mutters, 'I will not be wearing armor.'
source_quote: Daz stares mournfully at the armor and mutters, “I will not be wearing armor.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin opens the door to the guard room and examines the area past the rope bridge where Ilvara’s residence is.
source_quote: Thorin opens the door to the guard room, peaks outside, examines the area past the rope bridge where Ilvara’s residence is

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin decides leaving everything behind is good and shouts, 'Nah, let’s take advantage of the distraction.'
source_quote: Thorin looks at his Drow weapons and decides that leaving everything behind is good. A good, fresh start. He shouts, “Nah, let’s take advantage of the distraction.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz feels a thunderous drone and sees four black, bloated flies larger than a pony.
source_quote: Daz feels a thunderous drone, a discordant, raw hum that sets his teeth chattering.  He pokes his head and looks and sees four black, bloated flies. He can see these massive and terrible things, larger than a pony.

subject: chasme
fact: Daz identifies four chasme in the area.
source_quote: Demons: four chasme and two vrock.

subject: vrock
fact: Daz identifies two vrock in the area.
source_quote: Demons: four chasme and two vrock.

subject: Topsy and Turvy offer to retrieve gear
fact: Topsy and Turvy offer to retrieve the prisoners' gear for a price.
source_quote: We could get your stuff  for you for a price.

subject: Topsy and Turvy transform into rats
fact: Topsy and Turvy transform into rats.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy sigh and then transform into rats.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido clicks his tongue and points out that there are very large spiders.
source_quote: Buppido clicks his tongue and points out that there are spiders—very large spiders.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith mutters, 'The faster we get out of here, the better. Ilvara will be honor bound to pursue us. And let’s not give her more motivation. But — revenge is so tasty.'
source_quote: Sarith, who seems to be overcome with bouts of madness, mutters, “The faster we get out of here, the better. Ilvara will be honor bound to pursue us. And let’s not give her more motivation. But -,” and he cackles, “revenge is so tasty.”

subject: prisoners escape via waterfall
fact: The prisoners rush from the tower to the waterfall and slide down, landing in the water.
source_quote: So they rushed from the tower to the waterfall and slid down, landing in the water.

subject: gray ooze
fact: A gray ooze strikes Thorin with a crushing pseudopod.
source_quote: And strikes it does, landing a pseudopod with a crushing blow on Thorin.

subject: Menzoberranzan
fact: Menzoberranzan is a city full of Drow Cultists to the north.
source_quote: To the north is Menzoberranzan, a city full of Drow Cultists.

subject: Blingdenstone
fact: Blingdenstone is to the south and requires passing through the battle between Drow and Demons.
source_quote: Going south to Blingdenstone would require going through the pitched battle between Drow and Demons.

subject: Topsy and Turvy revert to gnomish form
fact: Topsy and Turvy transform back into gnomes and head down the passage to the Darklake.
source_quote: He sees Topsy and Turvy transform back into gnomes and head down the passage that leads to the Darklake.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum silently shares his thoughts with his friends and the other prisoners.
source_quote: Grygum silently shares his thoughts with his friends and the other prisoners.

subject: prisoners disengage from gray ooze
fact: The prisoners disengage from the gray ooze and run towards the tunnel to the Darklake.
source_quote: They all agree, disengage from the ooze, and run towards the tunnel to the Darklake.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin decides not to smash the gray ooze and rushes off.
source_quote: Even Thorin, tempted to smash the creature with his sword, decides it’s not worth it and rushes off.

subject: injured vrock
fact: An injured vrock lands on the cavern floor with abnormally long, muscular arms ending in raptor-like claws.
source_quote: an injured vrock lands on the ground. From this close, Daz notices its abnormally long arms, dense with lean muscle, that end in raptor-like claws, scraping the ground.

subject: injured vrock
fact: The injured vrock extends its feathered wings out and then back.
source_quote: The creature extends its wings, feathered wings out and then back.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz flees from the injured vrock to escape with his life.
source_quote: Although excited about the opportunity to study a vrock up close, Daz is more interested in escaping with his life and flees before the creature can strike him down.

subject: Ront
fact: Ront attacks the injured vrock with his first blow cutting through its hide.
source_quote: His first blow cuts through the creature's hide and the gangrenous blood-like substance that oozes out gives Ront hope that he has killed the monster.

subject: Ront killed by vrock
fact: The vrock kills Ront with one taloned hand and grabs his lifeless body with the other.
source_quote: But he hasn’t. The demon, with startling speed, kills him with one taloned hand, then grabs the lifeless body with the other while it’s beak envelops the head and snaps it off.

subject: vrock consumes Ront's head
fact: The vrock's beak envelops Ront's head and snaps it off.
source_quote: while it’s beak envelops the head and snaps it off.

subject: Ront's body falls behind escapees
fact: Ront's headless body lands on the ground behind Daz as he reaches the cave.
source_quote: A few moments later, as he makes it to the safety of the cave, he hears the thud of the now headless body land on the ground behind him.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar disrupts the group's sense of safety by asking who will die before escaping.
source_quote: Although Jimjar disrupts their feelings of safety, “Anyone wants to make a bet about how many of us will die before any of us escape?”

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido says the divine plan says he will make it to Gracklstugh.
source_quote: The divine plan says I will make it Gracklstugh.

subject: wager made between Jimjar and Buppido
fact: Jimjar and Buppido make a wager.
source_quote:
“Put your money where your mouth is?”
“Yes.” And a wager is made.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith says he was a member of the warrior caste and has explored the area thoroughly.
source_quote: Yes. I do. Before I was unfairly and unjustly imprisoned, I was a member of the warrior caste, and I have explored this area quite thoroughly.

subject: Darklake
fact: The Darklake is a network of underground rivers, natural tunnels, and canals connecting water-filled caverns and chambers.
source_quote: The Darklake is a network of underground rivers, natural tunnels, and canals that connect innumerable water-filled caverns and chambers.

subject: Darklake
fact: The Darklake stretches over a hundred miles across with ceilings miles high in some places and unfathomable depths.
source_quote: This vast waterway stretches over a hundred miles across, with ceilings that are miles high in some places and depths that are unfathomable.

subject: duergar
fact: Duergar engineers extended and widened many interconnecting passages of the Darklake.
source_quote: Long ago, duergar engineers extended and widened many of the interconnecting passages of the Darklake.

subject: duergar
fact: Duergar constructed locks for raising and lowering watercraft within the Darklake.
source_quote: They also constructed locks for raising and lowering watercraft to different levels within it

subject: kuo-toa
fact: Kuo-toa are experienced in navigating the Darklake.
source_quote: Many Underdark creatures are experienced in navigating the Darklake, including the kuo-toa.

subject: Sloopdopblop
fact: Sloopdopblop is eight days away from the Darklake.
source_quote: if what Shuushar says is true, the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: prisoners agree to travel via Darklake
fact: The prisoners agree to travel via the Darklake to reach Gracklstugh or other destinations.
source_quote: There is a moment of silence, and then they all agree.

subject: session date
fact: The group begins their march on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493.
source_quote: ## 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: Underdark tunnels
fact: The tunnels alternate between pitch darkness and light from the Faerzress.
source_quote: The tunnels alternate between pitch-pure darkness or lit with the surreal magic of the *Faerzress (*Fay-YERR-zess).

subject: Stool
fact: Stool is curled against Grygum when he wakes up.
source_quote: When he woke up, Stool, whom they had met as a fellow prisoner in Velkynvelve, was curled against him.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool says he is lonely, scared, and terrified.
source_quote: Stool explained that he was lonely, scared, and terrified.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool says he wants to be Grygum’s best friend.
source_quote: He knew he wanted to be Grygum’s best friend.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum tells Stool they can be friends.
source_quote: He sighed and told the creature that they could be friends.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum takes Stool's hand.
source_quote: When stool extended his hand, Grygum took it.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar shouts about a fungus he points at.
source_quote: “Well, look at this,” shouts Jimjar.

subject: fungus
fact: Thorin thinks the fungus looks like a giant’s tongue.
source_quote: Thorin thinks it looks like a giant’s tongue.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith says the fungus is the tastiest thing in the world.
source_quote: “Tastiest thing in the world,” says Sarith.

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar says eating the fungus connects the eater with the gods.
source_quote: It is said that when you eat this mushroom, you connect with the gods.

subject: Thorin eats the fungus
fact: Thorin eats the fungus and gets a vague psychedelic impression but feels no different.
source_quote: Thorin is dubious but chooses to eat the mushroom. He gets the vague impression that it has a psychedelic effect, but he doesn’t feel any different afterward.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'You know, that Myconid thing probably tastes delicious. And Shuushar, you really have big eyes.'
source_quote: “You know, that Myconid thing probably tastes delicious. And Shuushar, you really  have big eyes.”

subject: prisoners laugh at Thorin
fact: The prisoners from the Underdark laugh at Thorin’s comments.
source_quote: the prisoners from the Underdark start to laugh.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido asks Thorin if it is true what they say about Giants.
source_quote: Buppido asks Thorin, “So tell us the truth. Is it true what they say about Giants?”

subject: Thorin tells the truth
fact: Thorin attempts to lie but tells the truth.
source_quote: And Thorin attempts to lie but tells the truth.

subject: prisoners laugh harder
fact: Everyone laughs harder after Thorin tells the truth.
source_quote: And then everyone laughs even harder.

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar explains that the fungus is called *The Tongue of Madness* and compels its eater to tell the truth.
source_quote: *The Tongue of Madness* will compel its eater to say the truth.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir declares a vow of silence after eating the fungus.
source_quote: Zalthir stares at the group, ats the mushroom, and declares a vow of silence.

subject: group continues journey
fact: The group continues their journey into the dark after eating the fungus.
source_quote: Once they have eaten, the group continues their journey into the dark.

subject: rockfall in cavern
fact: A tremor is felt and rocks fall in the large cavern.
source_quote: They arrive at a large cavern, and as they stretch their arms, a tremor can be felt. And then, before anyone can react, rocks fall.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir examines the cavern after the rockfall.
source_quote: Once the dust has settled, Zalthir looks around.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum shouts that he is fine after being trapped under rocks.
source_quote: Grygum shouts that he’s fine

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is silent after being trapped under rocks.
source_quote: Grygum shouts that he’s fine, but Daz is silent.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir concludes Daz is unconscious and will die if not rescued soon.
source_quote: Zalthir examines the mage and concludes that he’s unconscious. And will die if he doesn’t get him out in time.
